column3: The Hebrew is difficult; NASB renders “capital” as “crown.” The meaning is uncertain.
“South” is rendered “right side,” and NASB adds “of cast metal.”
The Hebrew reads “lavers” (some manuscripts “pots”); NASB has “basins.”
“On the face of the pillars” is rendered “on the tops of the pillars.”
“Valley” is rendered “plain,” and “mold of the ground” as “clay ground.”
